tasks.title_clean: In shortener/store.go, implement type Store (a code→url map, a url→code map, and a sync.RWMutex), NewStore() *Store…
tasks.description:
In `shortener/store.go`, implement `type Store` (a `code→url` map, a `url→code` map, and a `sync.RWMutex`), `NewStore() *Store`, `Save(url string) string`, and `Lookup(code string) (string, bool)`.
- `Save` takes the write lock. If the URL already has a code, it returns that code (idempotent, FR-4).
- Otherwise it tries `codeFor(url, 0)`. On a collision with a different URL it increments `attempt` and re-hashes until the code is free, then records both maps.
- `Lookup` takes the read lock.
- The `url→code` map guarantees the same URL always gets the same code, even when a counter was needed.
